description: One person's answer to one yes/no or short-value question about how the CRM behaves for them. Site-wide configuration belongs in FCRM Settings; this table is only for choices that differ per user.

fields.description: Whose preference this is. A row is readable and writable by that person and by a System Manager, and by nobody else.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Which preference. Only keys registered in crm/fcrm/doctype/crm_user_preference/crm_user_preference.py are accepted, so this cannot become a general key-value store.
fields.label: Preference Key

fields.description: The stored answer. A checkbox preference stores "1" or "0".
fields.label: Preference Value

fields.description: user + preference key, enforced by a unique index. This is how one row per person per preference is guaranteed; Frappe has no composite unique constraint in a doctype definition.
fields.label: Preference Id

name: CRM User Preference
